lines: •Reaffirming 2026 Adjusted EBITDA(2), Distributable Cash Flow(2), and Free Cash Flow(2) guidance ranges of $2.750 billion to $2.950 billion, $2.050 billion to $2.250 billion, and $1.100 billion to $1.300 billion, respectively.

•Expect to be slightly above the high end of the 2026 total capital expenditures(3) guidance range of $850.0 million to $1.0 billion, driven by capital needs related to producers’ accelerating activity and WES’s investment in the Solitude Pipeline System.

“With a greater number of wells expected to come online relative to the third quarter, we expect strong fourth-quarter results and anticipate full-year Adjusted EBITDA above the midpoint of our guidance range of $2.750 billion to $2.950 billion.

We also expect 2026 capital expenditures to be slightly above the high end of our $850.0 million to $1.0 billion guidance range, reflecting our investment in Solitude and accelerating producer activity levels.”
